items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I played with him like that, and I know. He sounds fine with Leon. Leon plays a nice lead.

ctx.x: I never heard him with two trumpets. Oh, man.

You ought to hear him with two trumpets. He let somebody play a lead, you know? I played with him like that, and I know. He sounds fine with Leon. Leon plays a nice lead. Now, Prima. And they all play as a nice drive. A nice one.
You ever go to any boxing matches? Hear bands at boxing matches?
